scope: Removed Registry-only wrapper metadata notes; converter wrappers remain supported.

activeWrapperPolicy().purpose: Read the selected optional canonical-WETH policy; zero means unset.

wrapperPolicyExists(bytes32).purpose: Check whether an immutable wrapper-policy ID was approved.

wrapperPolicies(bytes32).purpose: Read the recorded wrapper admin, implementation, owner and code pins.

approveWrapperPolicy((address,address,ad.purpose: Append an optional reviewed policy for the canonical WETH proxy/admin dependency. Native custody does not require this policy. Exact admin/implementation/runtime/owner bindings are checked; no arbitrary wrapper address is admitted by this tuple.
approveWrapperPolicy((address,address,ad.access: Governance through the controller; before sealing, the bootstrap may also configure where canConfigure permits. No governance waiting period.

outputs.id: Immutable policy ID; approval does not activate it.

activateWrapperPolicy(bytes32).purpose: Select a previously approved optional wrapper policy after revalidation. Unknown or already active policy reverts. Does not convert ETH to WETH or authorize an unsupported principal-pair move.
activateWrapperPolicy(bytes32).access: Governance through the controller; before sealing, the bootstrap may also configure where canConfigure permits. No governance waiting period.

inputs.id: id is an approved WrapperPolicy hash.
